faqs.q: When will my order be dispatched?
faqs.a: Orders placed before 2 PM (PKT, Mon–Fri) are dispatched the same business day. Orders placed after 2 PM or on weekends are dispatched the next working day. You will receive a dispatch confirmation with a tracking number via SMS and email.

Currently, Alloyed Living ships within Pakistan only. We are expanding our logistics network and plan to offer international shipping to the UAE, UK, and USA in Q4 2026. Subscribe to our newsletter to be notified the moment it launches.

faqs.q: What if my package arrives damaged?
faqs.a: Every order is fully insured during transit. If your item arrives damaged or does not arrive within the stated window, contact us at hello@alloyedliving.com within 48 hours of the expected delivery date. We will arrange a full replacement or refund at no cost to you.

faqs.q: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
faqs.a: Address changes can be accommodated up to 4 hours after an order is placed, provided it has not yet been dispatched. Contact us immediately via WhatsApp or email. Once dispatched, address changes are handled directly with the courier and may incur a redirect fee.

faqs.q: How can I track my order in real time?
faqs.a: Once dispatched, you will receive an SMS with a direct tracking link from our courier partner. You can also use the order tracker at the top of this page. Tracking status is updated every 4–6 hours throughout the delivery journey.

All prices on Alloyed Living are inclusive of applicable local taxes. No additional duties apply for deliveries within Pakistan. For future international orders, all applicable duties and taxes will be clearly presented at checkout before you confirm your purchase.
